house.description: Minnesota State Colleges and Universities funding provided for hospital, medical, and dental benefits coverage to part-time or adjunct faculty; report required; and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Higher Education Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to provide hospital, medical, and dental benefits coverage to part-time or adjunct faculty; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; REPORT REQUIRED. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to provide hospital, medical, and dental benefits coverage to part-time or adjunct faculty who teach six or more credits in an academic year and currently are not offered hospital, medical, and dental benefits. This appropriation is also to collect data on participation that will allow for a more accurate estimate of the cost of this coverage on an ongoing basis. This is a onetime appropriation. The Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities must submit a report with collected data on participation and estimates of the cost for ongoing coverage to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with primary jurisdiction over higher education by November 1, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to provide hospital, medical, and dental benefits coverage to part-time or adjunct faculty; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; REPORT REQUIRED.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to provide hospital, medical, and dental benefits coverage to part-time or adjunct faculty who teach six or more credits in an academic year and currently are not offered hospital, medical, and dental benefits. This appropriation is also to collect data on participation that will allow for a more accurate estimate of the cost of this coverage on an ongoing basis. This is a onetime appropriation. The Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities must submit a report with collected data on participation and estimates of the cost for ongoing coverage to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with primary jurisdiction over higher education by November 1, 2027.
